speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Hello how's it going?

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: I am doing well, how are you?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Decent, bit of a slow start to the morning on Turk but it is the weekend so I guess that's expected

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: I'm new to this so I have no idea what to expect.  How long have you been doing it?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I've been working this for almost two years now. The busier season is starting as the colleges in the US will be started/starting soon so that helps

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: So obviously it's worth it for you.  Do you just do it in your spare time?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Yea it's definitely worth it to me. I do some at my work on days when its slow but mostly just in my off time instead of going on social media or something I come here

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: I guess it's a lot better way to waste time than seeing what a bunch of people I don't really care about are doing.  So when college is in there's less competition?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Haha exactly! When college is in session we get more studies/surveys posted as a lot of the work on Turk is done for academic reasons. So in the next couple weeks we'll see an influx of students doing their psychology studies and such via the platform.

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: Oh man, I didn't even think of that.  They have all the grant money to throw out too.  So how much time do you throw at this in a given week?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: It varies but generally a few hours on my workdays and maybe like 6 or 8 on my days off I'd say

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: That's pretty good.  I don't have that kind of time.  Any suggestions for a newcomer?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: On the task page sort so you see the newest HITs, and grab whatever looks good to you as far as surveys. I'd recommend being wary of doing multiple HITs for any 1 requestor until you vet them yourself because rejections early on in a Turk account can make getting better hits tough (a lot of the better hits require 99% or higher approval rating) - and remember you'll get a lot faster at it as you keep going, it can feel a bit slow and tough at the beginning but it does get better

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: Thanks, the last few days have been pretty boring, I was hoping to see more progress.  Are sureveys the way to go?  I've seen a lot of the website searching stuff too?  Is that stuff worth it?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Website searching can be good, it never hurts to try a HIT once - see how fast you can complete it and decide if it\'s worth doing more from there. One other cool thing about MTurk is that some studies allow you to donate money to a charitable cause directly from the task payment - This one we\'re doing now in fact allows us to donate towards a foundation called "Save the Children"

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: Oh really?  Where do you see that?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: At the end of the study they will ask if you'd like to donate from your payment to the foundation, they assist needy children all around the globe in dire situations. Would you be willing to donate any of your payment today to help save the kids?

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: I think so.  How do you see where the donation goes?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: It will tell you in a short blurb above the box to donate (I've done this HIT before in the past) and the researchers ensure 100% of any amount you donate goes to the kids. Even a small donation makes a big difference because there are so many of us making small amounts that it really adds up!

speaker: A1QSZMTORL9YB7
text: That's great.  Certainly something that needs to be done.  Have you had the opportunity to travel a lot?  I recently went to Africa and it gave me a new perspective on life.
